description: High-velocity multi-channel cadence designed to achieve first contact within SLA window.

campaigns.name: Instant Inbound Greeting & Confirmation
campaigns.copy: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, thanks for reaching out about {{property.address}}! I'm reviewing the property details right now. Are you looking to sell within the next 30 days or just exploring your options?

campaigns.name: Preliminary Cash Valuation Intake Email
campaigns.subject: Quick question regarding {{property.address}}
campaigns.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

I received your information regarding {{property.address}}. To ensure we provide the most accurate as-is valuation without requiring formal showings, could you reply with a brief note on the general condition of the roof and HVAC?

Looking forward to speaking with you shortly,
{{user.name}}
Acquisitions Specialist

campaigns.name: Soft Text Check-in
campaigns.copy: Hey {{contact.first_name}}, just wanted to make sure you got my earlier message. Is this the best number to reach you regarding the property?

campaigns.name: Rep Call Attempt #1 + Voicemail Drop
campaigns.instructions: Place call attempt. If no answer, drop VM-01: 'Hi {{contact.first_name}}, Hamza here following up on your property inquiry. Give me a quick call back when free.'

campaigns.name: Day 1 Morning Comp Check SMS
campaigns.copy: Morning {{contact.first_name}}! I pulled up the recent neighborhood sales around {{property.address}}. We have cash ready for a quick 14-day close if the numbers align. Do you have 2 minutes for a brief chat?

campaigns.name: How We Buy Houses As-Is Case Study
campaigns.subject: How we purchase homes as-is in {{property.city}}
campaigns.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Many homeowners we work with want to avoid paying 6% agent commissions, repair costs, and months of open houses.

Here is what our direct cash process looks like:
1. 10-minute discovery call
2. Written all-cash offer with zero contingencies
3. You pick your exact closing date (7 to 60 days)

Are you available for a brief discovery call today?

campaigns.name: Evening Convenience Text
campaigns.copy: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, I know days get busy. Feel free to text me a time that works best for you this evening or tomorrow!

campaigns.name: Day 2 Repair Burden Relief SMS
campaigns.copy: Hey {{contact.first_name}}, quick question on {{property.address}} — are there any major repairs needed (foundation, plumbing, roof), or is it mostly move-in ready? We buy strictly as-is so no repairs needed on your end.

campaigns.name: Zero Fees & Zero Commissions Breakdown
campaigns.subject: Keeping 100% of your proceeds on {{property.address}}
campaigns.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

When selling traditionally, closing fees and agent commissions typically eat 9-11% of your sale price. When selling directly to us:
- You pay $0 in commissions
- We cover 100% of standard closing costs
- Zero cleaning or haul-away needed

Let me know if you'd like to see our preliminary net offer.

campaigns.name: Rep Call Attempt #2
campaigns.instructions: Place second live dial. Check if lead prefers direct phone or SMS communication.

campaigns.name: Day 3 Cash vs Listing Comparison SMS
campaigns.copy: {{contact.first_name}}, wanted to check — are you looking for a full cash offer with a guaranteed closing date, or were you planning to list on the market?

campaigns.name: Neighborhood Sales Report
campaigns.subject: Recent property transactions near {{property.address}}
campaigns.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

I compiled a quick list of 3 recent property sales in your immediate neighborhood. Depending on your timeline, we can structure a clean cash purchase or a flexible terms offer.

Click here to book a 5-minute slot on my calendar: https://cal.com/hamzabuildai/discovery

campaigns.name: Short Check-in
campaigns.copy: Still interested in receiving our cash offer on {{property.address}}, {{contact.first_name}}?

campaigns.name: Day 4 Flexible Timeline SMS
campaigns.copy: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, one thing our sellers love is flexibility — if you need 30 or 60 days to move after closing, we can easily arrange that. Does that help your situation?

campaigns.name: Seller Testimonials & Verified Closings
campaigns.subject: What local sellers say about our process
campaigns.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Selling a property is a big decision. Here are a few stories from homeowners in {{property.state}} who needed a quick, hassle-free resolution.

Read our verified closing testimonials and see how we handle everything from probate to tenant issues.

Best regards,
{{user.name}}

campaigns.name: Rep Call Attempt #3
campaigns.instructions: Evening dial. If no answer, mark lead for weekend drip.

campaigns.name: Day 5 Ballpark Number Check
campaigns.copy: Morning {{contact.first_name}} — did you have a specific price in mind for {{property.address}}, or would you like to hear our underwriting assessment first?

campaigns.name: Simple 3-Step Closing Guide
campaigns.subject: Your closing timeline on {{property.address}}
campaigns.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Here is a simple overview of how escrow and title work when you accept our offer:
1. Title company opens escrow with initial earnest deposit
2. 5-day visual walkthrough & clear title verification
3. Title wires funds directly into your bank account

Reach out anytime to get started.

campaigns.name: Weekend Availability SMS
campaigns.copy: Hey {{contact.first_name}}, I'm available this Saturday morning if that's easier for a quick 5-minute phone review. Let me know!

campaigns.name: Day 6 Tenant & Occupancy Solutions
campaigns.copy: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, if {{property.address}} has tenants or stored items, no worries at all — we handle occupied properties and leave-behind items. Hope that takes some stress off!

campaigns.name: Common Seller FAQ
campaigns.subject: Frequently asked questions about our cash purchase process
campaigns.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Here are answers to the top 3 questions we receive:
Q: Do I need to clean out the house?
A: No, take what you want and leave the rest.

Q: Are there any hidden fees?
A: Zero. What we offer is your exact net payout.

Q: How fast can you close?
A: As fast as 7 days, or on your schedule.

Let's connect this week!

campaigns.name: Saturday Evening Nudge
campaigns.copy: Hope you're having a great weekend, {{contact.first_name}}! Still happy to help with {{property.address}} whenever you're ready.

campaigns.name: Day 7 Week 1 Wrap-up
campaigns.copy: {{contact.first_name}}, haven't heard back so I assume you may have other plans for {{property.address}}. Should I keep your file active or close it out for now?

campaigns.name: Week 1 File Status Update
campaigns.subject: Status update on your property file: {{property.address}}
campaigns.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

I wanted to follow up one last time this week regarding {{property.address}}. If the timing isn't right, no problem at all. We will transition your file to our monthly market update list unless you'd like an immediate valuation.

Best regards,
{{user.name}}

campaigns.name: Transition Confirmation SMS
campaigns.copy: No pressure at all, {{contact.first_name}}. I'll keep your details on hand in case anything changes down the road. Have a great week!
